info.name: Dhatri E-Commerce App API Collection (AmazCart/Amazy)
info.description: Comprehensive and fully functional Postman collection mapping all customer and marketplace APIs used by the Dhatri (AmazCart/Amazy) Flutter Application. This collection features correct HTTP methods, bearer token authorization, path/query parameters, and detailed sample request payloads.

request.description: Register a new user or merchant account in the Dhatri platform. Supports optional GPS coordinates (latitude/longitude), merchant details (store_name, gst_number), and documents/images via multipart form-data upload if matching merchant registration.
Authenticate user using their registered Email or Phone number. If a phone number is used, the key should be changed from 'email' to 'phone'. Returns a Bearer token used for authenticated requests.
Log in or sign up securely using third-party auth providers (e.g., Google, Facebook, Apple).
Fetch the currently authenticated user's profile details including basic info, wallet balance, and shipping/billing preferences.
Update account profile information for the authenticated user.

formdata.description: Image file to upload as the profile image.

request.description: Upload a new avatar/photo for the user's profile.
Triggers an OTP (One-Time Password) request to the user's email or phone number for COD orders validation.
Sends a password reset link or dynamic recovery code to the registered email.
Invalidates the active Bearer auth token and logs out the user securely.
Permenantly delete the logged-in customer account and clear associated data.
List all saved billing and shipping addresses for the logged-in user.

request.description: Modify the details of a specific address.
Delete a specific address by its database ID.
Set a specific address as the default billing address.
Set a specific address as the default shipping address.
Get all active countries available in the database for address selection.
List all states corresponding to a given Country ID.
List all cities corresponding to a given State ID.
Fetch homepage components including sliders, top deals, featured brands, categories, and top-pick products.
Retrieve full information of a single product (images, description, rating, shipping methods, and starting SKU variants) by ID.
Fetch precise pricing, stock availability, and wholesale tiers for a specific variant matching the attributes combination.
Browse and filter store products based on category, brand, and sorting parameters (new, low_to_high, high_to_low).
Fetch all categories with multi-level subcategories hierarchy.
Fetch lists of all brands registered in the marketplace.
Instantly search items using key phrases to fetch matches dynamically.
Fetch cart details including price totals, package groupings, and selected shipping values.
Add a specific product SKU variant or package item to the shopping cart.
Increase or decrease the quantity of an item already in the cart using its Cart Item ID.
Mark a cart item as active (1) or inactive (0) for inclusion in the checkout totals calculation.
Batch select or unselect all cart items sourced from a specific seller.
Select or deselect every item in the cart at once.
Remove a specific item from the cart.
Empty the shopping cart entirely.
Change the shipping logic or carrier preference for a package group.
Fetch checkout items, active shipping rules, tax values, and invoice sums.
Apply a coupon to reduce grand_total based on shopping thresholds.
Retrieve available delivery methods/couriers.
List all active electronic payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay, Paypal, COD).
Retrieve static bank account fields for direct wire/offline bank transfers.

formdata.description: 4 for Stripe, 1 for COD, 2 for Wallet, etc.

request.description: Submit and record the finalized order on the server. Requires details of address, items breakdown, payment mode, and gateway success ID.
Post gateway transaction success details before checking out order. Returns payment database entry ID required for 'payment_id' in order-store.
Verifies if pricing configurations or item stock counts have changed since adding them to the cart.
Fetch active, historical, or delivery-pending orders for the customer.
Filter user orders selectively matching processing states.
Get lists of pre-configured options for order cancellations.
Cancel an order or a specific pack inside the order by passing reason ID.
Get lists of options for issuing refund return tickets.
